newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Solvay extends Friday's bull run.
newsitem.headline: Solvay extends Friday's bull run.

text.p: Belgian chemicals and pharmaceuticals company Solvay SA, profiting from a wave of buying interest in industrial stocks, surged more than five percent to a new all-time high on Monday.
"A few stocks have broken out, everybody in Belgium is buying (Solvay) and it had been lagging the market a bit last year," said trader Tim Rovencamp at Ghent brokerage Nedee & Co.
Dealers also said investors were buying Solvay because of market optimism in its pharmaceutical activities.
At 1135 GMT, Solvay was up 4.7 percent at 21,575 francs after earlier touching 21,675 francs.
-- Paul de Bendern, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6812, Fax +32 2 230 7710
